title: Security Event (raw)
description: Raw event contract between the Attack Simulator (FR1) and the ingest API. Mirrors Lab 3 section 4. Frozen: change schema_version if any field changes.

schema_version.description: Bump on any breaking field change.

event_id.description: UUID generated by the simulator. Used downstream for dedup.

event_time.description: When the event happened, at the source. ISO-8601 WITH an explicit UTC offset. Drives event-time windowing.

ingest_time.description: Stamped by the ingest API on arrival. Any client-supplied value is overwritten.

src_ip.description: Source IP. Used as the Kafka partition key.

dest_ip_port.description: Destination as 'ip:port' (Lab 3 calls this dest_ip:port; a colon is awkward as a JSON key).

raw_payload.description: Free-form, unparsed extra fields. Not validated.
